## DE on 8 POAG samples vs 3 control samples. 

```{r}
gene <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel("gene_count_16.xls"))
```


```{r}
head(gene)
```

```{r}
#install.packages("BiocManager")  # If not already installed
#BiocManager::install("DESeq2")

library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
```


### Running DE on 11 samples (8 POAG, 3 cadaver controls):
```{r}
library(dplyr)

counts_matrix <- gene %>%
  select(gene_id, OS0658, OS21014, OD21014, AD24, AD25, RNA41, RNA45, RNA47, RNA48, RNA53, RNA44)
rownames(counts_matrix) <- counts_matrix$gene_id
counts_matrix <- counts_matrix %>%
  select(-gene_id)
counts_matrix <- as.matrix(counts_matrix)  # Convert to numeric


samples <- c('OS0658','OS21014','OD21014','AD24','AD25','RNA41','RNA45','RNA47','RNA48','RNA53','RNA44')
label <- c('CTRL','CTRL','CTRL','POAG','POAG','POAG','POAG','POAG','POAG','POAG','POAG')
labels <- data.frame(samples, label)
rownames(labels) <- labels$samples
labels <- labels %>%
  select(-samples)
```

```{r}
 ## Create a DESeqDataSet object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_matrix,
                              colData = labels,
                              design = ~ label)  # 'condition' should be a column in sample_info

# Filter low-count genes (optional)
#dds <- dds[rowSums(counts(dds)) > 10, ]

## Run DESeq analysis
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)
```


```{r}
# p values
res <- res[order(res$padj), ]
head(res)

# Filter for Significant DEGs (Adjusted p-value < 0.05, Log2FC > 1)
sig_genes_11 <- subset(res, padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
```

```{r}
# volcano plot
ggplot(as.data.frame(res), aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = sig_genes_11, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj)), color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("Log2 Fold Change") +
  ylab("-Log10 Adjusted P-Value") +
  ggtitle("Volcano Plot of Differentially Expressed Genes")

```

```{r}
# Heatmap of Top Genes
top_genes_11 <- rownames(sig_genes_11)[1:50]  # Select top 50 genes
all_genes_11 <- rownames(sig_genes_11)
normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
pheatmap(normalized_counts[top_genes_11, ])
```

```{r}
top_genes_11
```

Look at overlap between genes differentially expressed across 8 POAG (bad samples)/3 cadaver and 3 POAG (good samples)/3 cadaver:
```{r}
# all_genes_6 object here comes from DE_6.Rmd file

overlap <- intersect(all_genes_6, all_genes_11)
overlap
```
